what: Live checks against fa.wikipedia.org run by .github/workflows/live.yml (bench/live_check.py). Article text is not stored; counts only.

rehearsal.sample: 60 random namespace-0 articles of at least 3,000 bytes per run (no redirects, no disambiguation pages); a new sample each run
rehearsal.labels: bench/label.py, then every non-whitespace change read by hand in the CI log (Claude); hand review overrides the script

runs.notes: The 2 'wrong' were correct digit fixes (labeler counted Latin text inside templates). Debatable: spaces inserted inside chains of initials/acronyms (FA42), no longer produced.
All 109 wrong changes are in one article: FA01/FA02 folded ي/ك/ى inside Uyghur place names; the labeler had marked them correct. The 3 'wrong' were labeler errors.

regression_set.notes: Uyghur word after a closing parenthesis; fixed in d30d329

runs.notes: All 67 debatable: FA40 removed the space in list items like '* .us' (renders the same). FA40 skips list markers since.

templates.method: TemplateData, template source ({{{param|) and the invoked module, per template

citations.notes: Not in TemplateData, template source or the invoked module (citation/CS1/fa/dispatch), but fa.wiki's citer tool emits them. Left unchanged; asked of reviewers.
